page.content:
Laurie and the daughters who inherit the hunt.

How Strode family connects

  • Character: Laurie Strode — Laurie is the Strode survivor at the center of the cycle.
  • Character: Karen Nelson — Karen is Laurie's daughter in the 2018 timeline.
  • Character: Allyson Nelson — Allyson is Laurie's granddaughter in that same line.
  • Location: Haddonfield — The Strodes are a Haddonfield family.

What is Strode family?

The Strode family begins with Laurie as the 1978 babysitter-survivor and continues through Karen and Allyson in the later timeline.

Key threads lead to Laurie Strode, Karen Nelson, Allyson Nelson and Haddonfield.
